title: Create lighter one-bed Infinigen SPEAR import
objective: Implement the approved recovery plan for importing the one_bed_apartment Infinigen scene into SPEAR by regenerating a lighter scene, exporting it, importing it into Unreal/SPEAR, and reporting exact commands/logs/artifacts. Do not commit.
instructions: Use the same floorplan at /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment/one_bed_floorplan.json and seed 21.
Create a SPEAR-targeted lighter generation output, preferably /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment_spear_light/coarse or a timestamped sibling if the path already exists.

Regenerate with Infinigen using fast_solve.gin, terrain disabled, invisible room ceilings enabled, and compose_indoors.solve_small_enabled=False. Keep large and medium objects enabled for the first pass, with moderately reduced solve steps compared to the original heavy run.

Export r256 first. Before Unreal import, inspect polycounts.txt and FBX size. If the scene remains clearly too large for the current machine, stop and report; if it is still high-risk, regenerate fallback with compose_indoors.solve_medium_enabled=False as well.

Import into SPEAR using examples/flashlight/setup_infinigen_indoors.py with --no-auto-generate-collision --no-import-materials --no-import-textures, replacing the one_bed_apartment assets/map only for the selected light export.
Run long generation/export/import steps in tmux with timestamped logs so the user can attach and monitor. Include the tmux session name in the result.
If import succeeds, run the existing cook/build step needed for SPEAR to launch the map, using the established project workflow from docs/importing_and_exporting_assets.md.
Do not perform Git commits, pushes, rebases, or branch changes.
If you need to modify scripts to make this workflow robust, keep edits minimal and report them, but prefer using existing scripts/commands.
constraints: Tower is orchestrating; return a ResultPacket only.
Avoid retrying the known 3 GB r256 FBX import; the failure is already understood as geometry/static-mesh compile memory pressure.
expected_outputs: Exact output directories, log files, FBX path, map path, and tmux session name.
If blocked, provide the smallest next fallback and the evidence for why.
definition_of_done: Either the lighter one-bed map imports and cooks successfully, or a clear evidence-backed fallback is ready for the next Builder handoff.
